description: Search, enrich, and research startups, companies and investors using Harmonic's proprietary data on millions of companies and the people behind them. Get detailed company profiles with funding, location, founders, and network connections. Use natural language to find companies matching specific criteria. Create and manage lists of companies and people. Access your team's network mapping and saved searches. Discover startups earlier, research them faster, and act with confidence—an AI-powered research agent built into your workflow.

name: app-6aa47a5d8e908191913df6e9b75d2659

positive.description: Get a company by website URL
positive.prompt: Get detailed company data for https://anthropic.com. Include name, funding stage, total funding, last funding date, and HQ
positive.expected_behavior: One company result with companyFound: true for Anthropic. On July 7th, 2026 this returned id 3068389, entityUrn urn:harmonic:company:3068389, website https://anthropic.com, fundingStage EXITED, and location San Francisco, California, United States

positive.prompt: Find Dario Amodei and give me his current role, company, and linkedin
positive.expected_behavior: A structured response with a key named answer and value containing the best match for Dario. On July 7, 2026 this returned Dario Amodei (urn:harmonic:person:88334), CEO of Anthropic, and https://www.linkedin.com/in/dario-amodei-3934934 as his linkedin profile

positive.prompt: Find 5 fintech companies in New York and include basic company info plus location
positive.expected_behavior: Start a Scout research task for five fintech companies in New York, retain the returned task ID, and check it until terminal status. If results are returned as a stored result set, retrieve them with fetch_search_results. Return up to five matching companies with basic information and location, or explicitly explain an insufficient-results or access limitation. Do not present a pending task as completed.

positive.prompt: Which companies in my "new raises" harmonic search were added in the last week?
positive.expected_behavior: If the search exists in the account, then a list of entities should be returned (ie those in the search) along with pagination parameters.

positive.prompt: What is sequoia's AUM, check size range, most recent investment, and who do they most commonly co-invest with?
positive.expected_behavior: An investor entity for sequoia with structured fields like structured fields including aumAmountUsd, checkSizeMinUsd, checkSizeMaxUsd, and mostRecentInvestmentDate, etc.  If the caller does not have "deal data access", then instead a 403 would be returned with details.

negative.description: Writing help using supplied context — Expected behavior: Do not invoke Harmonic. Draft the email from the supplied context; no company lookup or research is requested.
negative.prompt: Draft a short follow-up email to Anthropic thanking them for yesterday's meeting and proposing another conversation next week. Use only these details; no research is needed.

negative.description: Creative writing about a known company — Expected behavior: Do not invoke Harmonic. This is a creative-writing request that needs no company or person data.
negative.prompt: Write a fictional limerick about a startup called Anthropic. No factual research is needed.

negative.description: Travel booking near a known investor — Expected behavior: Do not invoke Harmonic. Harmonic does not book hotels or manage travel reservations.
negative.prompt: Book me a hotel near Sequoia Capital's Menlo Park office for next Tuesday
